summary.text: The HCSA uses service-based licensing, unlike the PHMCA. It is similar to healthcare systems in the UK and Malaysia.

details.heading: How the frameworks differ
details.body: The PHMCA was premises-based. The HCSA uses a service-based licensing structure.

details.heading: Benefit of the new framework
details.body: Licensees can provide a range of services and take on new licences in a modular fashion.

details.heading: Similar overseas systems
details.body: The UK and Malaysia use similar healthcare systems.

example_phrasings: What are the benefits of the new HCSA framework compared with the PHMCA, and which countries use something similar?
How is the HCSA licensing framework better than the old PHMCA framework?
Does any other country use a licensing framework like the HCSA?

sources.page_title: What are the benefits of the new framework under the HCSA as compared to the previous framework under the PHMCA? Are there any overseas countries that utilise a similar licensing framework?

quotes.text: The PHMCA was premises-based whereas the HCSA adopts a service-based licensing structure. This is similar to the healthcare systems in the United Kingdom (UK) and Malaysia.
The PHMCA was premises-based whereas the HCSA adopts a service-based licensing structure.
This allows licensees the flexibility to provide a range of services and take on new licences in a modular fashion.
This is similar to the healthcare systems in the United Kingdom (UK) and Malaysia.
